description: Emits a particle effect at the impact location, optionally only for entity hits or only for non-entity hits.

num_particles.description: Number of particles to spawn per hit.

on_entity_hit.description: If `true`, particles are spawned when the projectile hits an entity.

on_other_hit.description: If `true`, particles are spawned when the projectile hits something that is not an entity.

additionalProperties.description: Filters allow data objects to specify test criteria which allows their use. Filters can be defined by a single object of type (Filter Test), an array of tests, collection groups, or a combination of these objects.

particle_item_name.description: Map from item identifier to a filter group, used to select an item icon for `iconcrack`-style particles based on context (e.g. the projectile's owner).

particle_type.description: Particle type to spawn at the impact point.

title: ParticleOnHitSubcomponentDefinition
